settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Set in the heading face in the header and the footer. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Tagline
settings.info: The line under the wordmark in the footer.

settings.label: Currency symbol
settings.info: Printed before every price and fee: $, £, €.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: Cards, tiles and steps fade up as the page scrolls. Never the first screen.

settings.label: Headings rise in
settings.info: The hero heading and page titles rise in word by word on load.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Printed as typed; the call links drop the spaces.

settings.label: Ask button label
settings.info: Book a free call, Request an appointment, Register your pet.

settings.label: Booking link
settings.info: Your online scheduler. Set: every ask button goes there. Empty: every ask button opens the appointment request.

settings.label: Booking page
settings.info: The page with the request form inline, for a browser without JavaScript.

settings.label: Confirm line
settings.default: We confirm by phone or text within one working day.

settings.label: Caution line
settings.default: Please don't include medical details here. We'll talk those through by phone.
settings.info: Always under the note field of the request form.

settings.label: Insurance line
settings.info: In-network with most major plans; we file claims for you.

settings.label: Registration lines
settings.info: One licence, registration or membership per line. Printed in the footer and the story.

settings.label: Patient forms
settings.info: Where new patients fill in their forms ahead.

settings.label: Emergency line
settings.info: Tooth pain? We keep same-day slots for emergencies. Empty hides the emergency band.

settings.label: Emergency phone
settings.info: Leave empty to use the phone.

settings.label: Footer note
settings.info: If this is a medical emergency, call 911.

settings.label: Call bar on phones
settings.info: A bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones: Call and the ask button.

settings.label: Email
